quotes.author: Tshieja Mukendi
quotes.text: Me and my wife spent a very enriching experience with Airlink Niagara Falls Tours Toronto. Shahz our driver picked us up at the designated location on time. He was explaining everything during the travel from Toronto to Niagara Falls. The price was affordable compared to other tour operators. I recommend Viator if you want to book a tour to Niagara Falls.

quotes.author: STivodar
quotes.text: An b+ / a - experience, still probably the best hassle-free way. All in all a nice trip. Boat and behind the falls are a must, maple tasting is underwelming and the Skylon Tower experience was dragged down by long wait times for elevators - we had very little time up and we almost missed the bus back to Toronto. Haroon, our guide, was great though.

quotes.author: Susan
quotes.text: It was an amazing day. Our guide/driver Shaz was super friendly and provided a fun and interesting commentary during the bus trip and at the Falls themselves. The day was well paced and we throughly enjoyed every part of the day especially the boat trip and the journey behind the falls. Many thanks to Shaz for a really great day.

quotes.author: Asha Talbert
quotes.text: Awesome Niagara Falls day and night tour with Kumar. He was so kind, resourceful, and clear with his guidance and communications. We were priviledged with exclusive savings at Maple Leaf Place, and skipping massively long line at Journey Behind the Falls. Highly recommend this tour if you're looking for a bit of everything.

quotes.author: Tena P
quotes.text: Niagara Falls Tour It was the ultimate birthday gift from my husband. Everything from the beginning of our pick up to the end of our tour was outstanding. Our tour guide ensured we had everything we needed for each stop & pickup along the way. I highly recommend Shad for any and all tours.

quotes.author: Janelle G
quotes.text: Very good As a tourist, I wish I knew beforehand that it would be a 9 hour day and that they were so many long stops before even making it to the falls. In all the guide was very knowledgeable and provided a good experience. It was worth it having a direct ride to and from.
